Max Verstappen took the win from pole for Red Bull, completing the Singapore Grand Prix in 1 hour 42 minutes 0.785 seconds. Charles Leclerc finished second for Ferrari, with Andrea Kimi Antonelli third for Mercedes. The classification shows a front-row winner and a strong recovery: George Russell climbed from nineteenth to ninth, while Isack Hadjar made up ground from twenty-second to score a point.
highlights: Isack Hadjar climbed from twenty-second on the grid to finish tenth, gaining twelve places.

Charles Leclerc set the fastest lap while finishing second for Ferrari.

review.summary: Taylor Barnard took a surprise win for DS Penske at the London E-Prix, climbing from sixth on the grid to take the flag ahead of Mahindra Racing's Nyck De Vries and Edoardo Mortara. De Vries converted his pole into second while Mortara added third. The classification also showed a strong recovery from Norman Nato, nine places up from nineteenth, and Oliver Rowland eight from seventeenth, while front-row starts for Pascal Wehrlein and Nico Müller faded to fourteenth and twelfth.
highlights: Norman Nato climbed nine places from nineteenth on the grid to finish tenth at the London E-Prix.
Joel Eriksson and Lucas Di Grassi did not finish, both starting fifteenth and twentieth respectively.
Taylor Barnard's win for DS Penske came from sixth on the grid.
